text:
maria.cruz: quick ask — i'm building a small spreadsheet of batch-size experiments and need the canonical grafana panels + trace/log queries for SM%, KV-cache hit rate, memory per-pool, and the per-pool batch distribution. mainly for prod (6h window) but also canary baseline. anyone know the single-panel links or saved queries?
ben.kim: there is a gpu throughput dashboard but panels are scattered. which env exactly? prod only or prod+canary? i can paste direct panel urls.
maria.cruz: prod primary, canary for baseline comparisons. also need guidance on which traces to attach for high-eviction events (what to capture).
jordan_lee: panel links i use: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/throughput/gpu-overview?orgId=1&panelId=42 and https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/throughput/gpu-kvcache?orgId=1&panelId=91

jordan_lee: Loki query for eviction logs (6h window):
```
{job="runtime", env="prod"} |= "kvcache_eviction" | json | line_format "pod=%{pod} pool=%{pool} evicted=%{count}"
```

jordan_lee: PromQL snippets i paste into the sheet:
```
# SM utilization by pool (instant vector)
sum by(pool) (rate(sm_cycles_busy_total{env="prod"}[1m])) / sum by(pool) (rate(sm_cycles_total{env="prod"}[1m])) * 100

# KV-cache hit ratio (6h avg)
avg_over_time(kv_cache_hit_ratio{env="prod"}[6h])

# batch size distribution (per-pool, last 6h)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_batch_size_bucket{env="prod"}[5m])) by (le, pool))
```

ops-bot: ALERT: kvcache_eviction_rate (gpu-prod) triggered for pool=decoder-heavy (threshold=5% per-min) at 14:23 UTC.

ben.kim: fwiw the eviction alert is noisy during scheduled bulk inferences. suggest we adjust for traffic pattern. maria — do you want me to add a recommended_alert_threshold column in your sheet?
maria.cruz: yes please — thinking set to 10% per-min for p95 traffic and keep 5% for small pools. we'll validate. also include a note to ignore maintenance windows.
sam_p: @oncall-ml fyi — batchsize experiments may trigger autoscale spikes; please monitor pod churn if we run larger batches.
jordan_lee: i pulled a trace for the noisy run: https://traces.redwood.internal/trace/3f2a1b showing repeated kv cache misses when batch_size > 32 on A100-40GB. seq len ~1024. captured spans: kvcache.lookup -> runtime.scheduler -> cuda_copy -> infer.
jordan_lee: short tip — when you attach traces, include the pod name + pool label and the top 10 spans; that helps correlate kv miss -> eviction.
ben.kim: ok added rows for prod + canary, columns: panel_link, promql_snippet, loki_query, trace_link, recommended_alert_threshold, owner. i'll ping owners in the sheet.
maria.cruz: perfect. i'll run the baseline tonight (6h run) and post results here. cheers.
ben.kim: :thumbsup: i'll also add a note to the alert runbook about ignoring scheduled bulk jobs.
jordan_lee: one more mem metric if useful: smem_used_bytes{env="prod", pool=~".+"} -> divide by 1e9 to get GB, or use the grafana field.
maria.cruz: thanks everyone — closing the loop for now, will reopen thread if the baseline shows high evictions.
